doc: Detection duties of the mishe-tauftauf2shell plant. Each is a producer (the only polling), a signal with max_age, and a resolver role. Exit codes: 0 GREEN, 2 RED, anything else a failed observation that ages to UNKNOWN.

duties.name: dispatch
duties.covers: a wake left open (started/unknown) longer than 30 minutes

duties.name: repo-change
duties.covers: git commit changes to the checkout: the producer observes HEAD, writes signals/repo-change.detail and wakes only docs on a new commit. Missing git or unreadable HEAD is UNKNOWN, never GREEN.

duties.name: readme-lint
duties.covers: README structure and achievement table: RED with exact line-level reasons when a table row is orphaned, a row has the wrong cell count, a required heading is duplicated/missing, or a report link is missing. The docs mind owns the repair; GREEN means the reader book still parses.

duties.name: omp-only
duties.covers: Plant-scoped hard engine policy: every declared role must have exactly one hy4-flash route under engine omp; any claude/codex/qwen route, missing route, legacy engine file, or generated unit naming a forbidden engine is RED and wakes operator. The pinned runtime also raises on forbidden construction.
